---
title: "Training instance pages"
---

### Switch off template mode {.unnumbered}

For your **first** training instance only, switch off template mode,
as you did on main in [Landing page](landing-page.qmd#switch-off-template-mode).
On your new branch:

1. In `data/website.yml`, change `template: true` to `template: false`.
   The yellow **Want to use this template?** banner disappears from the
   overview page.
2. Replace `README.md` with the README for a training instance: copy
   the contents of `docs/_template-README.md` over `README.md`. Then
   delete the note at the top, and fill in the parts marked
   **Write this yourself**.
3. Commit and push your changes.

Later training instances copy these changes from your previous training
instance, so you don't need to repeat them.
